brand_identity.name: Vasudha Skin and Hair Clinic
brand_identity.tone: Organic & Earthy mixed with Editorial Elegance. Premium, welcoming, trusting medical science, spa-like but medical.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-light
scales.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-semibold

rules: No generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond.
Never center align default text, prioritize optical asymmetry.
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: No pure black or gray; always use warm undertones.
Avoid large gradients; rely on textures and negative space.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke border-white/40.
surfaces.cards: Solid warm white background with 1px border (#E5E0D8), no heavy shadows. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surfaces.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs in Coral. Hover adds saturation and slight scale.

visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must use bg-black/30 or bg-white/20 maximum. Do not obliterate image visibility.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Use 2-3x typical spacing for 'breathing room'.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For Services: 'Tetris' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8 to gap-12). High density (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) for Admin Dashboard.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Mobile-first. Use optical alignment over geometric alignment.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Kinetic hero with a signature masked line-by-line on-load reveal using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis momentum scrolling is mandatory for premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle parallax moment for background/hero images using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee/ribbon (Serif font, pale bg, dark text, tracking wide) for clinic highlights.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Purposeful scroll-reveals. Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, service cards).

3d_and_creative_libraries.decision: No heavy 3D (R3F) needed for this local clinic to maintain trust and load speed, but use Framer Motion 3D for subtle card flips/reveals if needed, and react-fast-marquee for the editorial ribbon.

rules: Do NOT use HTML native components for advanced interactions.
Never use full transparent background for headers/dropdowns.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use text shadows if over images.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='appointment-cta-button').

pages_structure.Home: Kinetic Hero with CTA, Masked Reveal, Marquee for highlights, Intro, Services Grid preview, Book Appointment CTA.
pages_structure.About: Doctor Profile (Dr. Vasudha Varada) with Photo, Editorial Layout, Qualifications List, Clinic Story.
pages_structure.Services: Bento Grid of Services (Acne, Hair Fall, Laser, PRP, etc.).
pages_structure.Contact: Address, Map Embed, Enquiry Form, Contact Details.
pages_structure.Admin_Dashboard: High density grid layout for Enquiry Management and Service Editor. Functional, Shadcn-heavy.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for marketing) or lucide-react.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee, @phosphor-icons/react, sonner. Avoid raw HTML for complex components, use Shadcn.
instructions_to_main_agent.execution: Build the site using pure HTML/Tailwind for layout structure (bento grids, overlaps), Shadcn for interactive logic. Ensure mobile-responsiveness and data-testid on every interactive element.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Enforce generous spacing (p-12 to p-24). Implement the Lenis scroll and Framer Motion reveals as requested. DO NOT center-everything.
instructions_to_main_agent.whatsapp_float: Implement a fixed bottom-right floating WhatsApp button.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, parallax).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use placeholder text for images or logos; rely on the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
